title: Nine-figure inventory misclassification
impact: A nine-figure amount had been misclassified in internal inventory data for five years.
cause: A one-character typo in a mapping literal, plus an unanchored pattern match that matched far more than intended.
fix: Ran an AI-assisted audit comparing what each pipeline claimed to do with what its code did, then verified every candidate against real data.
result: Both defects surfaced; peer data teams adopted the method the same week.

title: Lab networks with monitoring blind spots
impact: Lab network availability had missed target for seven months.
cause: About half of the Wi-Fi access points weren't covered by central monitoring.
fix: Onboarded Wi-Fi alerting into central monitoring, doubling coverage to ~2,500 access points, and drove remediation with the team.
result: 99.5% availability, the first time in seven months.

title: 40-terabit backbone capacity drain
cause: An automated traffic-shift workflow got stuck mid-run and left circuits drained.
fix: Paged into the incident; worked with the response team on the fix that recovered the stuck workflow and un-drained the circuits.

title: Capacity stranded by oversized tickets
impact: ~3 Tbps of capacity left stranded and unusable.
cause: Network tickets failed to create when descriptions exceeded a size limit, so capacity-restoration work never started.
fix: Root-caused it and landed a fix that truncates oversized descriptions safely.

title: Critical-ticket flood from outage automation
impact: Critical-ticket volume inflated by mis-prioritized automation.
cause: Priority misassignment in the outage-automation logic.
fix: Traced the misassignment and corrected the priority mapping.

title: Workflow API timeouts
impact: Network workflow automation calls timing out.
fix: Re-implemented the APIs on a push model.

title: Legacy intake down ~3 hours a week
impact: Network-ops email intake failed for about 3 hours every week.
cause: A fragile legacy helpdesk ingestion path.
fix: Built a replacement email-to-ticket pipeline with three ML classifiers routing requests.
result: 99% availability across 45,147 emails, ~20× fewer outage hours.
